The main takeaway from our work is that
the paleoecological conditions of the Arkose ridge Formation at Box canyon were similar to the meander-land depositional system of the nearby Chickaloon Formation.

the paleoclimate estimates for this high-latitude setting were similar to those of the more distal meander-plain settings of the Chickalloon Formation, and that the paleoclinate of high-latitude settings in the Paleogene was likely not as warm as the global average.

, despite the high-latitude location of the Box Canyon section, the paleoenvironmental conditions and paleoecological dynamics were similar to those of the Chickalloon Formation, which is interpreted as being deposited at a lower paleolatitude.
